items.name: Auto Axe Crafting
items.description: Bring The Pitt's most lethal make-shift weapon back to Appalachia when you learn to craft the Auto-Axe!  - ITEM IS CRAFTABLE AT WEAPON WORKBENCHES. -

items.name: Bare Rusted Steel Union Power Armor Paint
